messages.subject: Big Question!
parts:
Hello you all,

It is maybe an easy question to answer but i have been wondering myself many times why do autors in different articles from important and high qualify journals, estimate population densities, apparently, without testing normality and determinating parametrism?

Is it because all these tools and methods are assumed as non parametric?

Or just because we are estimating density itself (based on a critical variables, say distances) and not the relevance of each one?

Please correct me, because i am probably very wrong and provide relevant articles as a contribution to ignorants in this field.
